text: A student who was studying weather did fieldwork to measure and record rainfall at her school. To
extend her fieldwork she decided to compare her results with data from a weather station at the
local university about 50 km away from the school.
The student decided to investigate the following hypotheses:
Hypothesis 1: At the school rainfall is higher on days when the wind is blowing from the
Hypothesis 2: Rainfall is higher at the school than at the university.

wealth.
